title: CB-001: Definition of eukaryotic cells
content: Eukaryotic cells are cells that contain a nucleus.

title: CB-002: Examples of eukaryotic organisms
content: Eukaryotic cells are found in plants, animals, fungi, and protists.

title: CB-003: Three key features of eukaryotic cells
content: All eukaryotic cells have a cell membrane, cytoplasm, and genetic material enclosed in a nucleus.

title: CB-004: Definition of prokaryotic cells
content: Prokaryotic cells are cells without a nucleus.

title: CB-005: Examples of prokaryotic organisms
content: Prokaryotic cells are found in bacteria.
